contributions.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED ($6,820.00) on the p2 Summary Page, restated at line 4 'Total Contributions Received (From Line 1 Column A)' AND printed a third time on the filer's own p6 summary sheet as 'Period Contributions $6,820.00'. The county's Schedule A (p3) carries NO subtotal — it is struck through with 'Refer to attached Spreadsheet' — so the ledger's own period segment is what the anchor gates.
contributions.detail: The 6 contribution lines in the ledger's PERIOD segment (p5, the block below the printed 'Remaining Balance 5/11/2010 $846.30' rule-off) sum to 500.00 + 200.00 + 4,000.00 + 400.00 + 1,700.00 + 20.00 = 6,820.00 exactly = Column A = line 4 = the p6 'Period Contributions' line. The segment boundary is the DOCUMENT'S OWN, not an inference: the ledger prints 'Total Contributions $3,550.00' and then a dated 'Remaining Balance $846.30' line before restarting, and 846.30 is exactly the line 3 'Balance at Beginning of Reporting Period' on this filing's own cover. The four lines ABOVE that boundary (3,550.00) are the PRIOR period, already itemized under this filer's May report, and are deliberately NOT republished here: this module's promoted anchor is the PER-PERIOD cell and republishing them would double-count. Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' prints 10,370.00 = 3,550.00 + 6,820.00 and is retained as cumulative, never summed as an increment; the p6 sheet prints the same figure as 'Total Contributions'. The balance ladder closes on the period figures: 846.30 (line 3) + 6,820.00 (line 4) = 7,666.30 (line 5); 7,666.30 - 6,664.58 (line 6) = 1,001.72, the printed line 7 close, which the p6 sheet repeats as '10/20/2010 Remaining Balance $1,001.72'.

expenditures.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE ($6,664.58) on the p2 Summary Page, restated at line 6 and printed again on the filer's own p6 summary sheet as 'Period Expenditures $6,664.58'. The county's Schedule B (p4) carries no subtotal — it too is struck through with 'Refer to attached Spreadsheet'.
expenditures.detail: The 8 expenditure lines in the ledger's PERIOD segment sum to 150.00 + 3,558.69 + 291.00 + 619.68 + 495.75 + 645.00 + 404.02 + 500.44 = 6,664.58 exactly = Column A = line 6 = the p6 'Period Expenditures' line. The 20 lines above the segment boundary total the ledger's own printed 'Total Expenditures $2,703.70' — the May report's figure — and are not republished here for the same anti-double-count reason. Column B YTD 9,368.28 = 2,703.70 + 6,664.58 and is retained as cumulative, never summed.

itemized.in_kind_convention: MONETARY-ONLY on both sides, tested rather than inherited. Nothing on the landscape ledger is marked in-kind, the ledger prints no in-kind column or line, the county's Schedule A/B blanks print none either, and the p2 Summary Page has no separate in-kind line — so the monetary-only and monetary-plus-in-kind conventions give the identical sums (6,820.00 / 6,664.58) and both close on Column A. NOTE what IS on the ledger and is NOT in-kind: two 'Loan from Doug Witney' lines (1,000.00 + 2,000.00) in the PRIOR-period segment. They are candidate loans the filer books inside his own printed 'Total Contributions $3,550.00', not in-kind gifts, and they belong to the previous period; see the notes for what that reclassification means.

itemized.notes: PAGE-FACE candidate name 'Douglas Witney' (Republican, residence city Springville); index.csv names NO candidate for this row. Page-face Office Seeking reads 'Utah County Commission SEAT B', agreeing with index.csv. THIS FILING IS AN AMENDMENT: the cover ticks 'Seven days preceding the General Election' AND ticks 'Yes' on 'Is this report an amendment?', writing '10-20-2010' on the Date of Report line; it is signed 10-20-2010 and stamped received OCT 25 PM 1:51. It is ONE report, not a multi-report bundle, so no report_index is set. The p2 Summary Page's own top-right Page/Last Name/Date box is left WHOLLY BLANK, and the printed label of line 3 is partly overprinted by the form's 'Refer to Line 7 on your last report' arrow so that only '...orting Period' shows — the line is still line 3 and carries 846.30. A SOURCE PROPERTY THIS BRIEF DID NOT LIST, AND A THIRD VARIANT OF THE ADDENDUM A2 PATTERN: THE COUNTY'S SCHEDULE A (p3) AND SCHEDULE B (p4) ARE BOTH PRESENT, BOTH EMPTY OF ENTRIES, AND BOTH VOIDED BY THE FILER — each carries a single handwritten line on its first ruled row reading 'Refer to attached Spreadsheet' and one large diagonal stroke drawn across the whole grid, with the 'Subtotal for this page' and 'Total ... Received' cells left blank. That is NOT an `empty-schedule` state (the filer did not report zero entries) and NOT `no-schedule-page` (the pages exist): the entries are real and live on the attached ledger, so both sides are `transcribed` and the arithmetic gate is the cover plus the ledger's own printed totals. Compare this filer's MAY report, which had no county schedule pages at all; his OCTOBER report has them and cancels them. THE LEDGER IS CUMULATIVE AND IS RE-PRINTED IN FULL EACH REPORT, divided by the filer's own dated 'Remaining Balance' line, and p6 is a one-line summary sheet restating Period/Total Contributions and Expenditures and the 10/20/2010 remaining balance. WHAT THE AMENDMENT ACTUALLY CHANGED, visible only by comparing the ledger's prior-period block with the May filing: in May the contribution ledger carried TWO typed lines (500.00 + 50.00 = 550.00) plus a HANDWRITTEN 3,000.00 'Personal loan' annotation that the May cover assigned to line 3, Balance at Beginning. In this October reprint that annotation has been TYPED IN and SPLIT INTO TWO ledger lines — '5/1/2010 Loan from Doug Witney $1,000.00' and '5/11/2010 Loan from Doug Witney $2,000.00' — and the block's printed 'Total Contributions' is now $3,550.00: the filer has RECLASSIFIED his own loan from an opening balance into contributions, and Column B here (10,370.00 = 3,550.00 + 6,820.00) carries that forward. Nothing was recomputed or adjudicated; the prior-period rows are not republished (they belong to the May report's own record) and this note exists so the change is not silently lost. Not a *_Redacted.pdf — the county published this era in the clear, so donor street lines are plainly visible on p5 and were reduced to city/state at READ TIME; none reaches any field or note. Three period donors' Address cells are simply EMPTY (Republican Party twice, Janene Crane) — left blank by the FILER, not redacted by the county.
